verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable, event-triggered rules. Automations are time-based recurring schedules, which are not event triggers. Filter Functions that intercept messages are Python building blocks a developer would have to code a rule system from. The webhooks are notifications for completed responses or inbound channel posts, not configurable event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
